en:
I understand how Gonta feels... I do not
wish for anymore victims, either...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Keebo for a while?

I have no doubt that Monokuma will prepare
a new <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL> for us...

But the only way we'll win is if we stand
together like never before.
<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo and I shared a passionate conversation.
<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo and I grew a little closer today.
